user.title: iCatch DVR add-on
user.description: Usually not needed: the iCatch DVR add-on announces itself to Home Assistant ("New device discovered" notification). For a manual setup, first set the add-on's "api_password" option, then enter the admin user and that password here. The host is the name shown at the top of the add-on log.

hassio_confirm.title: iCatch DVR discovered
hassio_confirm.description: Add the cameras of the {addon} add-on to Home Assistant?

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.description: The add-on exposes {count} camera(s). Tick the ones to add to Home Assistant: each gets an HD entity and a light "Preview" entity.

error.no_cameras: The add-on exposes no camera. Check its "cameras" option.
